lessons.trigger_condition: V385 learns a verified local neural policy and bounded capability recipes, but Tablet GPT and TCG Grader do not yet feed independently verified action outcomes into a shared fail-closed consensus layer; therefore one side cannot automatically detect strong verified disagreement or benefit from repeated peer corroboration without copying peer state.
lessons.prevention_rule: V386 must exchange only strict verified-outcome summaries, train a bounded 8x6x1 mutual-consensus neural model only on matching independently verified actions, keep both domains' model weights and raw state isolated, hold mutation on strong verified peer divergence, preserve V385/V382/V381 hard gates, export current local summaries for the other domain, and keep new source-level functions as non-executable protected-PR/CI proposals.
validation_required: watched paths are main, tablet_autonomous_evolution_v386.py and tablet_runtime_manifest.py
main evolve route uses tablet_autonomous_evolution_v386.py with tablet_gpt domain
tablet runtime manifest includes v386 while preserving v385 through prior controllers
peer summaries use an exact field allowlist and reject stale, extra-field, raw-state, raw-weight and calibration payloads
mutual neural training requires matching actions with independently verified sample counts on both sides
strong verified reward divergence blocks mutation before the V385 mutating cycle
missing or stale peer evidence never fabricates peer confidence and falls back to V385 local policy
peer evidence can never force execution or bypass V385/V382/V381 hard holds
source-level function additions remain non-executable plans requiring protected PR/CI, regression, integrity, alignment and actual-output validation
market adaptation remains operational regime/KPI/drift adaptation only and never predicts market direction
physical Tablet runtime and Drive readback remain unverified until matching external evidence exists
lessons.safety_boundary: V386 adds bidirectional verified learning summaries and a mutual-consensus neural layer only; it never imports peer model weights/raw state/grading calibration, generates or rewrites source code, executes arbitrary commands, writes Git/main, weakens verification, auto-promotes facts/prices/grades, predicts market direction, or claims physical-device success without evidence.
